snippet.title: Abu Batata is now available on Android! 🇪🇬🍠
snippet.description:
Abu Batata is now available on Android!

Experience the streets of Egypt as a sweet potato vendor.
Cook potatoes, serve customers, upgrade your cart, and enjoy a story inspired by Egyptian street life.

📱 Android Demo Available Now
💻 PC Demo Available on itch.io

🎮 Download:
https://ygstudio.itch.io/abu-batata 

💬 Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/RzcJ7M5gEM

If you enjoy the game, don't forget to leave a rating and share your feedback.
Every comment helps improve the full version.

Made with ❤️ in Egypt.



#لعبة #العاب #مطور_العاب #ابو_بطاطا #العاب_اندرويد #العاب_كمبيوتر #مصر #GameDev #IndieGame #AndroidGame
